title: Add a local research shortlist
objective: Users can retain selected sources without needing an account.
outcome: Selected product/context IDs, generation and optional user-entered notes are stored locally. No credentials or source payloads enter local storage. Private notes are never automatically sent to enrichment or telemetry. Duplicate clicks do not duplicate a source. Stale entries retain their original context and offer explicit refresh. A user can select sources, navigate away, return and deliberately clear the list. Shortlist success does not mean the source is scientifically suitable. Exactly six data-result-region values remain. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Implement add/remove and restore
commits.instructions: Add visible controls on results/detail and a workspace list using canonical IDs. Detect unavailable or changed generations on reload.

commits.subject: Support accessible shortlist management
commits.instructions: Provide keyboard operations, status announcements, empty state and count. Link each selection back to its exact source context.
commits.verification: A user can select sources, navigate away, return and deliberately clear the list on desktop/mobile.
